class_grouping_rules.exact: Scalar references retain their single required direction; alternatives and joint-required references retain the complete deduplicated answer set and semantic type.

families.diagonal: straight-left, straight-right, down-left, or down-right scalar references or combinations confined to diagonal labels
families.horizontal: left, right, or multi-label combinations containing only left/right
families.mixed_multi_direction: multi-label references whose labels span more than one family
families.u_turn_other: u-turn; retained separately rather than forced into vertical/forward
families.vertical_forward: straight or down scalar references or combinations confined to those labels

class_grouping_rules.multi_family_rule: Any multi-label reference spanning constituent direction families is assigned to mixed_multi_direction.

configuration.highly_unstable_prediction_definition: at least four distinct deduplicated prediction sets across seven conditions
configuration.paired_odds_ratio_interval: large-sample log interval when both discordant cells are nonzero; otherwise omitted
